Bike Roswell! Wednesday Evening Ride

Roswell, GA

No-drop

Bike Roswell! Wednesday Evening Ride is a road group ride in Roswell, GA. It meets every Wednesday, 6:30 pm, starting at Roswell United Methodist Church parking lot. Expect about 20–25 miles, A 18+ mph, B 16–17 mph, C 14–15 mph.

About the Bike Roswell! Wednesday Evening Ride group ride

Volunteer-run community ride in Roswell. Twenty to twenty-five miles in pace groups; leaders stay with anyone who falls off. Waiver required. Check the Facebook group to confirm the ride is on.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
